Xbox Game Pass Wave 2 titles have been revealed, and there are some big open-world heavy-hitters. author: IGN
description:
As part of IGN's 30th anniversary celebrations we're opening up the secret vault where we store all the consoles, games, accessories, and paraphernalia we've collected over the years. IGN Entertainment co-founder Peer Schneider and longtime host Daemon Hatfield are digging through years of well-loved consoles, dev kits, unfinished instruction manuals, rare controllers, game prototypes, and so much more.

This isn't just a storage facility — it’s a time capsule containing relics of the gaming industry’s most iconic eras.
title: Exploring the IGN Vault: The Full 30th Anniversary Tour - IGN30

author: IGN
description:
Check out the Total Chaos teaser trailer for the survival horror game. New Game+ is coming to Total Chaos, as familiar chapters return as far more hostile gauntlets, featuring new story content, new locations, a brand-new ending, and a relentless new stalker enemy. Total Chaos is available now on PC, PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and Game Pass. Total Chaos's New Game+ mode arrives on March 2, 2026.

New Game+ unlocks after completing the game and reimagines the first seven chapters of Total Chaos with more aggressive enemies, brutally scarce resources, and constant pressure. The nightmare culminates in an entirely new final chapter: Chapter 8 – Reckoning.

#IGN #Gaming
title: Total Chaos - Official New Game Plus Teaser Trailer
